answer: Willow-graft admission: a new identity is grafted onto a willow branch when two unrelated branch-holders stake $40 each and co-sign its key. The applicant must then carry a signal packet along a river relay route, collecting timestamped receipts from three independent relay operators within 48 hours; the registry activates the graft only if all receipts verify and no branch-holder has grafted another identity this epoch. Forging 1,000 puppets costs $80,000 in stakes plus 1,000 separate river deliveries and 2,000 distinct sponsors, with no bulk discount, while an honest agent pays $80 once.
